candidate.name: intraday_transaction_price_dispersion_resolution_2h
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A volume-weighted executed-price distribution that narrows from morning to afternoon indicates price discovery convergence and reduced disagreement into the close, which may persist over the next three sessions.

exact_formula.weighted_quantile_estimator: For tau in {0.25,0.75}, sort active x_i ascending with a stable sort and take the smallest x_i whose inclusive cumulative weight is at least tau times total active half-session weight.
exact_formula.support: Require D_m>0 and D_a>0 with no epsilon, clipping, fill, tolerance or fallback.
exact_formula.interpretation: Higher means greater afternoon narrowing relative to morning. A common multiplicative unit change in amount/volume cancels inside each IQR.

comparison_contract.direction_normalization: use every comparator's frozen score direction

ordered_no_return_gates.name: binding_source_snapshot_formula_implementation_and_verification
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Before any historical minute value, freeze and test the pure formula and then freeze a source-bound builder. After publication verify every partition byte/frame hash, exact volume-amount-only projection, grid, half split, active-bar rules, weighted quantiles, formula, support, range, counts and aggregate digest.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: structural_coverage_variation_and_capacity_before_comparator_values
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: On the immutable quality/current-listing base require median daily coverage >=0.95, P05 daily coverage >=0.90, P05 eligible names >=50, at least 200 non-overlapping three-signal-session cohorts, at least five observed years, all finite values in [-1,1], and at least 200 nonconstant cross-sectional sessions. Failure stops before comparator, daily-price or forward-return values.

ordered_no_return_gates.name: all_139_numeric_uniqueness_after_coverage_only
ordered_no_return_gates.rule: Compare in exact v135 numeric order with all 139 eligible numeric comparators. Each comparison requires at least 50 paired names per session and at least 100 qualifying sessions. Every absolute median daily average-tie Spearman correlation must be strictly below 0.8; insufficient overlap fails closed and no comparator may be removed.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.purge: Purge three signal sessions at every train/validation boundary; t+1 entry and t+3 exit must remain in the same partition.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.execution: Reuse the frozen one-factor next-open to third-close Top-3 engine, CNY 200000 board-lot pilot, quality/listing gates, amount-participation checks, 0/5/10/20bp cost grid and survivor gates without override.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025: Open once only if the sole trial survives every 2019-2023 gate and a nonzero survivor record freezes the campaign; label historically exposed quasi-out-of-sample. Otherwise keep closed and unread.
